name: Warm welcome
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity desktop homepage design mockup for Pets4Luv Foundation, a cat and dog rescue. This is a stakeholder design concept, not a working website. Portrait canvas approximately 1536 x 2048 showing a desktop website at 1440px width from header through several meaningful homepage sections. Straight-on flat screenshot; no device frame, no perspective, no presentation-board margins. Excellent readable typography, intentional spacing, realistic attractive cat and dog photography. Reference image 1 is the existing organization logo: retain this exact red heart, paw and navy PETS 4 LUV FOUNDATION logo in header as a small intact image on white, without redesigning or recoloring it. All other visual design is new. Header links: Adopt, How adoption works, Volunteer, About; secondary Donate button. Adoption is primary goal. Include a clear search/filter path, featured animals of the week with three or four sample animal portraits and names, and a visible conversational helper that supports finding a pet and adoption/care/volunteering questions. Do not show fake numerical achievements, fabricated testimonials, or invented addresses/fees. Animals and microcopy are illustrative; tiny footer note 'Design concept • Sample animals'. Keep text concise and correctly spelled. Distinctive professional art direction, usable layout, enough white space.
DIRECTION 1 — WARM WELCOME. Understated, comforting, organic, soft ivory #F7F2E8, forest green #243C32, muted clay accents. Elegant friendly editorial serif headlines with clear sans serif UI. Header small white logo tile left. Airy two-column hero: left large headline 'A little love. A whole new life.' short copy 'Meet the cats and dogs ready for their next chapter.' primary forest button 'Find your companion', secondary text 'How adoption works'. Right large softly arched photo of a friendly dog with smaller overlapping rounded cat portrait. Minimal organic curves, no cartoon paw wallpaper. Below hero a slim cream search strip: Cats & dogs, Age, Size, 'Search animals'. Next generous heading 'This week’s lovely faces' and three equal warm photographic cards Luna cat, Milo dog, Olive cat, age/category and Meet link. Below an open pale green panel with heading 'Not sure where to start?' and an integrated single chat entry field 'Tell us about your home and lifestyle…' plus small suggested prompts 'Find a pet' 'Adoption questions' 'Pet care'. Bottom start of two simple volunteer/care links. Layout calm and welcoming, photos glow with natural daylight.

DIRECTION 2 — BIG PERSONALITIES. Joyful, contemporary playful nonprofit brand. Sunflower yellow #FFD850, cobalt blue #2549D8, peach and white. Heavy chunky rounded grotesk typography, crisp dark outlines, occasional handdrawn star or heart. NO serif, NO muted green. Layout deliberately unlike conventional split-hero: full-width yellow top hero with huge centered two-line headline 'Small paws. BIG personalities.' under compact nav. Cutout happy scruffy dog enters from lower left and expressive tabby cat from lower right, surrounding large central blue 'Meet your new best friend' pill button. Directly below hero a prominent white selector strip with chunky outlined pills 'All animals' 'Cats' 'Dogs' 'More filters'. Next a staggered 4-column 'The meet-cute starts here' grid of colorful framed adoptable animal photos, different pastel backgrounds, names Luna, Milo, Olive, Teddy and concise age tags. Small angled label 'This week’s stars'. Next cobalt blue horizontal section with cream heading 'Your questions. Our helping paw.' with a large white conversational question input and chips 'Help me find a pet' 'How do I adopt?' 'Can I volunteer?'. Rounded sticky chat tab 'Let’s find your match'. Energetic but clean, accessible and readable. No generic stock corporate design.

name: Find your match
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity desktop homepage design mockup for Pets4Luv Foundation, a cat and dog rescue. This is a stakeholder design concept, not a working website. Portrait canvas approximately 1536 x 2048 showing a desktop website at 1440px width from header through several meaningful homepage sections. Straight-on flat screenshot; no device frame, no perspective, no presentation-board margins. Excellent readable typography, intentional spacing, realistic attractive cat and dog photography. Reference image 1 is the existing organization logo: retain this exact red heart, paw and navy PETS 4 LUV FOUNDATION logo in header as a small intact image on white, without redesigning or recoloring it. All other visual design is new. Header links: Adopt, How adoption works, Volunteer, About; secondary Donate button. Adoption is primary goal. Include a clear search/filter path, featured animals of the week with three or four sample animal portraits and names, and a visible conversational helper that supports finding a pet and adoption/care/volunteering questions. Do not show fake numerical achievements, fabricated testimonials, or invented addresses/fees. Animals and microcopy are illustrative; tiny footer note 'Design concept • Sample animals'. Keep text concise and correctly spelled. Distinctive professional art direction, usable layout, enough white space.
DIRECTION 3 — FIND YOUR MATCH. Exceptionally clean search-first modern adoption directory. White, cool pale gray #F4F6F8, dark navy #172A42 and small teal #087F82 highlights. Restrained sans serif typography, generous disciplined grid, fine borders, very subtle shadows, modest 10px corner radius. NO giant decorative hero, NO serif, NO doodles. Header logo left small, nav center. Compact introductory header: 'Your new best friend is closer than you think.' with single supporting sentence. Then immediately a large functional discovery area dominating upper fold: left sidebar 240px with heading 'Find your companion', Cats/Dogs toggle, Age dropdown, Size dropdown, lifestyle chips, dark teal 'Show matches' button. Main area 2-column pet results grid with rich photographs, names and concise age/species metadata; tiny 'Featured this week' tag on select cards. RIGHT column about 340px distinct visible chat panel headed 'Let’s find your match' with helper text 'Tell us about your home, or ask about adoption.' Example user bubble 'I’m looking for a calm adult cat.' helper response 'Let’s start with adult cats. What else matters to you?' and chips 'Living with dogs' 'Adoption process' 'Pet care' plus message composer. No unverified compatibility claims. All three columns align at top so gallery and chat feel like one search experience. Below this practical search surface a quiet full-width weekly intro section 'A little extra love goes a long way' with small animal photo and editorial text about senior and special-needs pets. Small volunteer/care links footer. High-quality product UI, immediately useful, friendly without ornament.

White slim masthead with intact supplied logo on left. Huge edge-to-edge cinematic photograph across upper half: soulful senior golden dog at eye level resting in sunlit home with cat subtly visible in background; dark gentle gradient makes left-aligned large cream text perfectly legible: 'Every animal deserves a next chapter.' Secondary line 'Help them find theirs.' Cream rectangular primary button 'Meet the animals'. Below photo a horizontal editorial index bar 'FIND A FRIEND' with Cats / Dogs / Age / Size and 'Browse all animals →'. Next section asymmetrical magazine layout: left one large cat photograph with caption 'Luna • This week’s spotlight'; right heading 'Some love stories take a little longer.' a short warm weekly introduction and two stacked compact portrait stories 'Meet Milo' and 'Meet Olive'. Then burgundy invitation strip 'A good match starts with a conversation.' with pale chat input 'Ask about a pet, adoption, or volunteering…' and Send arrow. A restrained persistent bottom-right button 'Ask Pets4Luv'. Feel emotionally resonant, confident, cinematic, sophisticated yet approachable. Distinct from green cozy, yellow playful, and directory designs.
